name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Agent Skill Marketplace package for auditing brand websites across AI discoverability, fact quality, freshness, entity identity, structured data, crawl/render accessibility, and on-site AI engagement.
author: Shivam

skills.name: Audit Orchestrator Skill
skills.description: Master orchestrator skill coordinating end-to-end brand AI readiness audits by invoking specialized audit skills.

skills.name: Crawl & Render Audit Skill
skills.description: Audits website robots.txt, sitemaps, HTTP headers, DOM rendering, and crawler accessibility for AI user agents.

skills.name: Structured Data Audit Skill
skills.description: Validates Schema.org JSON-LD, Microdata, OpenGraph, and semantic markup for AI entity extraction.

skills.name: Fact Quality Audit Skill
skills.description: Evaluates factual precision, claim verifiability, content clarity, and hallucination vulnerability across brand assets.

skills.name: Freshness & Corroboration Skill
skills.description: Checks timestamp metadata, update cadence, external citation consistency, and cross-source corroboration.

skills.name: Entity Identity & Consistency Skill
skills.description: Audits brand entity attributes, NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency, Knowledge Graph alignment, and canonical branding.

skills.name: On-Site AI Engagement Audit Skill
skills.description: Assesses on-site search readiness, conversational endpoint availability, and interactive AI agent interoperability.
